scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R index.html ringlampe_viewer.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js og-image.jpg icons www/
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
